settings.sg_title_text: Build Your Career on a {{Strong Foundation.}}

settings.editor: At Rigrent, we don't just lease machinery—we forge careers. We are looking for highly motivated leaders, mechanically inclined specialists, and master operators who want to scale their careers alongside the fastest-growing heavy equipment fleet in the nation.
Full medical, dental, and vision insurance for all full-time employees and their families completely covered by RigRent.
Reimbursement programs for CDL licensing, heavy machinery certifications, and mechanical engineering degrees.
We match up to 5% of all employee 401(k) contributions from day one to ensure your future is as secure as ours.
Full medical, dental, and vision insurance for all full-time employees and their families completely covered by RigRent.
